title: S2d cache-aware disclosure in shadow: context router gains cacheability and invalidation-cost inputs, tool catalog stable L0 plus dynamic L2, skill catalog stable ids (P8, P9, P10)
spec:
orchestrator/context_router.py: each routed evidence decision row gains cacheability (stable|semi|dynamic, from evidence source_type and freshness: repo files at a pinned commit are stable, memory semi, tool outputs dynamic) and cache_cost (tokens the presented text would add to the dynamic suffix, using cache_telemetry ratios) and a shadow field cache_adjusted_level: the level the router would choose if effective cost replaced raw tokens in its budget rule; recorded on the existing context_route decision_log rows; the presented level is unchanged unless [context_router].cache_mode is active (add cache_mode = "shadow" with a dated comment). orchestrator/tool_catalog.py: add a stable Level-0 catalog (names and one-line purposes of every known tool, identical across tasks of a role) and keep the dynamic Level-2 schemas for the minimal set; [tool_disclosure].cache_mode (shadow: record on the tool_disclosure decision rows the size of the stable catalog vs the current dynamic list and whether the dynamic list changed since the previous task of the same role; active: present the stable catalog plus the dynamic selection). orchestrator/skill_router.py: the presented skills section gets a stable compact catalog line block (ids and triggers of every active skill for the role, sorted) ahead of the selected full instructions; [skills].cache_mode likewise shadow-first with the same measurement. All three log through the existing decision_log kinds (extend row fields, no new kinds). Docs: docs/hermes-hardening/10-cache-aware-disclosure.md with the measured shadow numbers over the real decision_log rows of this repository.
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. The interface contracts of the stage 1 modules are in .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and in docs/hermes-hardening/0*.md on this branch; read the merged module before building on it.
